purpose: Turn the M3HL Detector 0 manifest/label contract into a reviewable future annotation-packet authoring plan without mutating data, labels, manifests, tensors, model cards, runtime code, final gates, or claim surfaces.

tier0_clip_manifests.readiness_boundary: These are approved PopSign raw-video/tensor clip rows. They are not frame-level or temporal Detector 0 annotation rows.

current_annotation_packet.readiness_boundary: Useful existing manual context rows remain sparse single-frame candidate evidence. They do not satisfy split coverage, temporal, hard-negative, held-out IoU, false no-hand, false trigger, or browser-latency prerequisites for full Detector 0 training/evaluation.

negative_challenge_manifest.readiness_boundary: Validation-only reject evidence exists, but it is not a Detector 0 box/no-hand training manifest and must not be silently promoted into training rows without source approval.

target_schema_policy.schema_change_policy: This plan does not change the Detector 0 target schema. Any change to promoted target ids, coordinate space, target fields, or target authority requires a later human approval or ESCALATE route.

auxiliary_table_target_policy.allowed_future_use: May remain as table-scoped auxiliary accounting when each row clearly marks it outside the promoted Detector 0 card target list.
auxiliary_table_target_policy.not_allowed_future_use: Must not substitute for right_or_second_hand, left_or_first_hand, or full Detector 0 readiness, and must not create product/runtime authority.

left_or_first_hand.current_candidate_rows: present in 32/32 packet rows; train 11, validation 11, test 10; positive support across dad, grandpa, hat, please, and table
future_packet_requirements: positive frame rows by train, validation, and test split across every selected Tier 0 label
explicit absent rows only when human review confirms no visible left_or_first_hand rather than a missing annotation
occlusion, truncation, and low-visibility bookkeeping for face/head contact and edge cases
temporal sequence rows that show center and box stability across multiple frames
held-out validation/test IoU rows at 0.30 and 0.50 with target-specific false no-hand accounting
left_or_first_hand.known_gap: The current packet has no hard-negative/no-hand rows and too few held-out IoU/temporal rows for a high-recall detector claim.

right_or_second_hand.current_candidate_rows: present in 20/32 packet rows; train 7, validation 7, test 6; positive support is table-only; please, dad, grandpa, and hat currently record absent rows
future_packet_requirements: table positive rows remain split-balanced, but table-only support must be labeled as insufficient for a general second-hand detector
absent/not-applicable semantics for non-table labels must be explicit and separated from missing annotations
human review must decide whether selected labels need additional true two-hand examples or whether absence is an expected label property
occluded, truncated, and low-visibility second-hand cases must be counted separately
held-out validation/test IoU rows at 0.30 and 0.50 plus false no-hand and false trigger accounting
right_or_second_hand.known_gap: Right-hand support remains table-only unless a later reviewed authoring slice adds non-table positives or records an approved target-policy decision.

head_or_face.current_candidate_rows: present in 32/32 packet rows; train 11, validation 11, test 10; auxiliary context support across all selected labels
future_packet_requirements: keep the target role as auxiliary context, not ASL correctness authority
positive/absent, occlusion, and truncation accounting by split
source, signer, clip, frame, annotator, reviewer, and source-rights provenance on every row
held-out validation/test IoU rows if Detector 0 emits this target
claim-surface proof that head_or_face cannot enable recognition pass/fail by itself
head_or_face.known_gap: The current candidate rows do not establish held-out IoU behavior or target-specific fail-closed browser behavior.

upper_body_or_signing_space.current_candidate_rows: present in 32/32 packet rows; train 11, validation 11, test 10; auxiliary signing-space support across all selected labels
future_packet_requirements: record exact semantics for upper body versus signing space before authoring more rows
positive/absent, occlusion, truncation, and low-visibility accounting by split
temporal sequence rows for signing-space stability, jitter, and missing-frame behavior
held-out validation/test IoU rows if Detector 0 emits this target
fail-closed browser proof until a promoted scratch-trained Detector 0 artifact exists
upper_body_or_signing_space.known_gap: The current candidate rows do not prove temporal stability, held-out IoU, or browser-latency behavior.

reviewer attestation that the row is not merely incomplete

source_rights_checks.raw_video_only_separation: Raw-video approval does not approve source-provided pose, landmark, embedding, detector, feature-cache, crop, pseudo-label, or generated-label artifacts.

popsign_v1_original_videos.allowed_for_future_packet: raw video/frame/tensor rows and project-authored manual boxes/regions with attribution and provenance
popsign_v1_original_videos.not_allowed_for_future_packet: preview videos or source-provided derived pose, landmark, embedding, detector, feature, generated-label, or pretrained artifacts

first_party_browser_consent_capture.allowed_for_future_packet: only after signer registry, clip-level consent, consent form version/hash, raw clip hash, and label review approval are recorded

online_negative_challenge_mixed.allowed_for_future_packet: validation/test reject-only Detector 0 rows with exact-file provenance and explicit source_license_decision
online_negative_challenge_mixed.not_allowed_for_future_packet: training hard negatives or general source-family reuse without a later source-review receipt

per_row_required_checks: source_license_decision and source_license_review_status are copied into the row
allowed_label_annotation_scope matches the exact derivative type used by the row
annotation_source is human-authored or explicitly source-approved for the exact source
reviewer verifies that no MediaPipe, OpenPose, YOLO, SAM, DINO, CLIP, RTMPose, from_pretrained, pretrained=True, pretrained feature cache, or generated pseudo-label supplied the target

review_steps_for_future_authoring: Select candidate clips or exact negative-challenge rows from tracked manifests without importing new media.
Before drawing or accepting each row, verify source_id, split, signer hash, source record id, source license decision, and allowed use.
Author human boxes/regions in normalized full-frame top-left xyxy coordinates, or attach only explicitly source-approved labels for the exact derivative type.
For every absent target, record absence_reason and target_applicability so absence cannot be confused with missing annotation.
Perform independent reviewer pass that either accepts, corrects, rejects, or marks insufficient_visual_evidence for each row.
Summarize split counts, target present/absent counts, occlusion/truncation counts, temporal counts, hard-negative counts, and held-out IoU rows before any training/evaluation route is considered.
Run existing source-register, no-pretrained, Detector 0 manifest contract, strict-gate, JSON, and diff checks; do not create a parallel audit system.
